  • Constructor Details

    • OperatingInputs

      public OperatingInputs(double topPressureBara, double bottomPressureBara, double reboilerTemperatureKelvin, double condenserRefluxRatio, int keroseneSideDrawTray, double keroseneSideDrawFraction, int dieselSideDrawTray, double dieselSideDrawFraction)
      Create validated atmospheric-column engineering controls.
      Parameters:
      topPressureBara - column-top pressure, in bar absolute
      bottomPressureBara - column-bottom pressure, in bar absolute
      reboilerTemperatureKelvin - reboiler outlet temperature, in kelvin
      condenserRefluxRatio - condenser reflux ratio, dimensionless and non-negative
      keroseneSideDrawTray - bottom-up NeqSim tray index for the lighter liquid side draw
      keroseneSideDrawFraction - fraction of tray liquid withdrawn, in [0, 1)
      dieselSideDrawTray - bottom-up NeqSim tray index for the heavier liquid side draw
      dieselSideDrawFraction - fraction of tray liquid withdrawn, in [0, 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a value is non-finite or outside its physical or topological domain
